training.selection: minimum validation cell-macro Poisson deviance; final test once after completion

selected_models_reason: SGFormer and Utonia scratch R2 were best skeleton and point baselines in the closest matched H01 global regression task; R38 uses frozen dense-support CMM/RCM implementation.
point_scope: Point encoder sees only shared real-surface point features; regional spatial queries and exposure are shared task information, without graph edges or paths.
target_scope: Complete observed neurite tree. No compartment labels or service radii read. All postsynaptic sites mapped by L2-anchored local path projection.
acceptance: All real models passed train-cell pilot; source freezing then acquisition of all 538; shared preparation; train extrema across nodes, regions, points, queries, patches, incidences, context voxels, point voxels and raw-group size.
schedule: All three full-shape acceptances before any formal training; sequential SGFormer, R38, Utonia; fixed training-only geometric controls after neural runs.
pilot_review: Unused upstream mask token caused the first Utonia acceptance assertion to fail after successful backward. Reviewed record retained; fixed actual encoder-update check passed. Later maximum-shape audit broadening does not alter pilot/model/data behavior.
test_policy: Validation selects minimum primary metric during the fixed 50 epochs. Each selected model evaluated on test once after training. No test-based protocol or hyperparameter adaptation.
